text_block_list.text:
One day, when I stopped by the library,
I found Sweep Tosho absorbed in some research.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Found it! This is definitely the one.
I knew I saw it before!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph, of course I'm doing a good job! That's just obvious!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: More importantly, I gotta hurry or they'll catch up with me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "*Thorns☆Thorns☆Entwine!!*"

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Found you, Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Eep! Why?! 
I totally cast an entangling spell on you!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, you're with her too.
Well, you see, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
She didn't do her homework, and when I tried
to keep her for supplementary lessons, she ran off...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh!
There's no waaaay I'm staying after class! Absolutely not!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, why didn't my magic work?!
I followed the spellbook to the letter, too...!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, Sweep Tosho.
I'm not just assigning homework for the sake of it.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Balancing your studies with your training is crucial for your
future as an athlete—the homework is meant to help you practice that, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Be quiet, don't tell me what to do!
If I don't wanna do it, I'm not doing it!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho!

As their voices grew louder, disapproving glances began to gather around us.
I needed to calm them both down before things got out of hand.
choice_data_list: Excuse me, would you mind leaving this to me?

text_block_list.text:
After moving to the Trainer's office, I tried once more
to persuade Sweep Tosho to finish her homework, but—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, not you too! "Homework, homework," that's all my familiar talks about!
I thought you drove that teacher away for me?!
choice_data_list: You still have to do your homework.
You have to do your homework.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then my familiar should just do it for me!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No it's not!
You're my familiar, so you have to obey your master's orders!

With that, Sweep Tosho began throwing a tantrum.
Refusing to even look at things she's not interested in is honest in a way, but...
I suddenly remembered how she acts once her interest is sparked.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Found it! This is totally the one.
I knew I'd seen it before!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why are you just standing there being quiet...?
choice_data_list: Why don't we clear your homework with magic?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...You mean using magic to fill in the answers?
Hmph, well that sounds kinda fun.
choice_data_list: That could work, but what if we cast magic on you instead?
That could work, but how about casting magic on you instead?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Magic on me? What's that supposed to mean?
choice_data_list: We'll cast a spell that lets you solve problems super fast!
We'll cast a spell so you can solve problems super fast!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, isn't that kinda roundabout?
You mean... like a speed-boosting spell, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Oh well, whatever! That sounds fun too!
Here goes――

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: “In a flash, take flight! Alstroemeria☆!”

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright, question one is...!
Ha, this is a piece of cake!

As if a real spell had been cast on her,
Sweep Tosho breezed through her homework with brisk efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now for this one... Uh oh, my speed's dropping!
“Gallop forward and solve, Alstroemeria☆!”

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, I finished it in no time at all!
Behold, familiar! That's the power of the magical girl Sweepy!

Whenever she puts her mind to something herself,
she truly shines with brilliant splendor.
choice_data_list: I knew it, your magic really is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, well of course! Now I can leave Teacher speechless!
I'm gonna go blow her away right now!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
—Every single answer is correct. Honestly, you can do it when you try,
so stop running away. And another thing—

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Your Trainer helped you with this, right?
Make sure you thank them properly later!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugggh!! Why are you talking about my familiar
instead of being amazed by my magic?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine then, I proved homework is a breeze with magic.
You won't ever get to make me stay after class again!

Sweep Tosho's eyes sparkle with lively energy as she speaks.
It became clear once again that she truly excels when it's something she enjoys.
